task.title: HealthKit current-day priority and bounded September 23 Activity repair

result.summary: The exact Build 57 batching/coalescing implementation was audited and the starvation defect was confirmed. The selected Native design gives Activity and Nutrition an exact-current-local-day lane that runs before the preserved Build 57 historical scope, while both retain the Server automatic namespace; a persisted historical batch can therefore no longer block current-day query, upload, acknowledgement, or revision state. The separate September 23 tool will be exact-day Activity-only and dry-run-only in production, with APPLY hard-disabled absent a future explicit authorization capability. Implementation and tests are in progress; nothing was mutated or uploaded.

tests.summary: Architecture audit complete. Focused, mutation, and complete relevant Native HealthKit suites remain pending.

review.summary: Fresh-context independent adversarial review will run only after the exact Native candidate is committed and focused/full relevant tests pass.

zero_write_audit.summary: Only source/report reads and public live/ready health reads occurred. No Founder device operation, production data write, Server mutation, upload, policy/strategic change, Strength/Logger mutation, or Cardio work occurred.

unexpected_findings: Sorting current day first inside the existing batch would be insufficient because Build 57 resolves a persisted pending historical batch before issuing any new query.

The existing foreground sequence completes Activity history before beginning Nutrition, so Activity historical recovery can also delay Nutrition current-day freshness unless all current-day scopes are scheduled first.
backlog: Implement and test the isolated exact-current-day Activity/Nutrition lanes while preserving the Build 57 scope for bounded historical recovery.
Implement and test the Founder-only September 23 Activity dry-run tool with a hard-disabled production APPLY gate.
Mutation-test critical guards, run the relevant Native HealthKit suites on only iPhone 17 Pro, obtain fresh-context review, and publish the final exact candidate.
recommended_next_step: Continue the authorized Native implementation/test/review work. Do not archive, upload, operate the Founder device, apply the repair, change policy/strategic eligibility, or begin Cardio.
